Issue No. 36 · Week of 31 August 2026 · 4538 published listings

Global Public Tender Weekly Digest

Asaptic publishes the complete sanitized weekly listing of public-sector tenders from Hong Kong, Singapore, Macau, the UK and Australia — publicly browsable, with category, summary, rough value band, and closing window for every row. Free registration at portal.asaptic.com is only needed to request the full supplier specification pack for a listing (no source-department identifiers) — built for mainland China and Hong Kong suppliers bidding into public-sector procurement across these five markets.

Frequently asked questions
What is included in the free weekly tender listing?
The complete sanitized list of public-sector tenders from Hong Kong, Singapore, Macau, the UK and Australia published this week — category, summary, rough value band, and closing window per row — sourced from government departments and public bodies & institutions. No registration required to browse the listings.
Do I need to register to see the tender listings?
No. The full sanitized weekly listing is free and public. Registration at portal.asaptic.com is only needed to request the full supplier specification pack for a specific tender.
Who is this tender digest for?
Suppliers in mainland China and Hong Kong who want to bid into public-sector procurement across Hong Kong, Singapore, Macau, the UK and Australia — covering both government departments and public bodies & institutions.
How often is the list updated?
Weekly, covering newly published tenders and their closing deadlines for that week.
Listings are summarized from publicly available government and public-body tender sources across Hong Kong, Singapore, Macau, the UK and Australia. Asaptic is not the procuring body for any tender referenced here and is not affiliated with any of these governments.
